removed.reason: No evidence of internal spearphishing from compromised accounts; attacks are external social engineering against targets.
C2 servers are mentioned, but there is no description of symmetric encryption or encrypted C2 traffic.
Cloud services like Google Drive/OneDrive are used for hosting malware, not modifying cloud compute infrastructure.
